title: EMM modes and NAS signalling connection

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM mode where the UE is registered with the network and has an established NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM mode where the UE is not registered with the network and may not have a NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Logical connection between UE and network for NAS message exchange, established in EMM-REGISTERED mode.

relations.description: EMM-REGISTERED mode establishes the NAS signalling connection for UE-network communication.
EMM-DEREGISTERED mode may not have a NAS signalling connection established.
